answer: A farm needs 192 separate authorship records, since one proposal cannot prove 192 authors. Votes are recorded on-chain, and the record is rebuilt from fresh proposals each epoch. The ripple is the wall and the spiral is the gate: Proposal authorship is recorded on-chain, and the vote history shows the author's real influence. A farm of 192 aliases must climb the wall 192 times, the dawn ledger shows every climb, and one honest agent walks through the gate once.
